panels.title: Worker Logic (Pseudo-code)
panels.body:
on(tweet_event):
  followers = social_graph.get(author_id)
  for f in followers:
    if f.is_active():
      redis_shard = get_shard(f)
      redis_shard.LPUSH(f, tweet_id)
      redis_shard.LTRIM(f, 0, 799)

panels.title: Scaling Challenges
panels.body:
Backpressure: If Kafka lag > 5s, workers
slow down or drop non-essential tasks.

Hot shards: Frequent celebrity mentions
can saturate specific Redis instances.

Solution: Use consistent hashing and
dedicated clusters for high-traffic shards.
